title: RigorLoop Allocated Requirement
description: Draft allocated obligation with explicit 5W2H analysis, acceptance criteria, and one accountable Module. Its single SR parent is supplied by directory containment, not a repeated field.

constrains.description: Optional constraints on logical Functions; does not duplicate parentage or functional allocation.

type.description: The entity kind; filenames and identifier prefixes must agree with it.

status.description: Only the initial draft lifecycle state is defined by this profile.

statement.description: The authoritative lower-level obligation derived from the containing SR and assigned to the accountable Module.

problem.description: The problem or gap being analyzed.

desired_outcome.description: The intended outcome in context; explain rather than duplicate the authoritative statement.

rationale.description: Why the need or obligation matters.

value.description: Additional benefits, when useful to distinguish from the rationale.

stakeholders.description: Participants with a stake in the need or obligation.

affected_users.description: Specific affected user groups, when useful to distinguish from the stakeholders.

conditions.description: Applicable triggers, conditions, or lifecycle stages.

frequency.description: An established frequency when relevant; omit when inapplicable or unresolved. Assess consequential uncertainty using the requirement-analysis method.

contexts.description: Applicable engineering contexts, environments, or boundaries.

approach.description: Approach at the requirement's level. Record additional imposed restrictions in top-level constraints.

scope.description: Coverage, extent, and exclusions of the need or obligation.

scale.description: An established scale when relevant; do not invent targets to fill the field.

limits.description: Established quantitative bounds, each authored once without duplication in constraints.

acceptance_criteria.description: Observable expected outcomes, not execution evidence.

assumptions.description: Provisional premises relied upon in the analysis. An empty list records no additional assumptions; it does not establish certainty.

constraints.description: Additional imposed restrictions with a basis in sources. Store each restriction once; keep scope boundaries and quantitative limits in their designated analysis fields.

open_questions.description: Optional single consequential unresolved question requiring a decision or evidence. Omit this field when none remains. Ask one question at a time; do not bundle independent questions. Engineering review assesses relevance and completeness.

allocated_to.description: Exactly one accountable Module in this authoring profile.
